verdict.rationale: Neon documents its own controls over how long data lives and how it is removed. neon.ts lets you set per-branch TTLs for auto-expiring branches. The MCP server exposes project delete and recovery plus scheduled snapshots, and project cleanup can be automated through the API. However, there is no documented configuration of the history/point-in-time retention window and no description of what deletion actually purges or when. missing for 10: configurable history/PITR retention window, documented deletion and purge guarantees (including backups), account-level data deletion policy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
